decisions.reason: Because this yogurt sits in the core dairy range and had early award-based validation, management would likely keep backing it unless sustained weakness makes range simplification necessary.
As a home-page flagship linked to the firm's stated direction, this cheese carries the strongest public commitment and is the product management would be most reluctant to abandon.
This semi-hard cheese fits existing cheese capabilities, but with no special public profile its protection from withdrawal is weaker after several years if results remain only middling.
Because this spicy cheese was launched as a multi-model line, the firm has more sunk effort and justification pressure in it and would tend to adjust the line rather than drop it outright.
This washed-rind soft cheese remains within the firm's competence base, yet compared with more visible launches it is easier to cut if management wants to free resources after a longer market test.
